name: Retry a queued run when a slot frees
description: Starts queued work the moment capacity frees: when an agent run finishes, the guardrails resolve the oldest queued task waiting on that slot and emit agent.slot_freed (at most one wake per freed slot — no thundering herd). Tasks still assigned to the queued agent restart through the standard assignment loop (acknowledge → run → In review); queued mention replies run directly. Every restart passes the normal admission gate, so a lost race simply re-queues. The hourly stale-work sweep re-emits the wake for queue entries a lost event left behind.

en.name: Retry a queued run when a slot frees
en.description: When an agent slot frees, restarts the oldest queued task through the assignment loop or runs a queued mention reply directly.

config.description: Closed, archived, or breaker-paused tasks don't restart.

steps.name: Still assigned to the queued agent?

config.description: Assigned work restarts through the full assignment loop; a queued MENTION reply on someone else's task runs directly without touching the assignment.

parameters.instructions: Your earlier run on this task was queued behind a concurrency limit and a slot has now freed. Read the recent comments to see what was asked of you, do it with your task tools, and post your reply as a task comment.
